summary: U Power Ltd, a Shanghai-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K covering its interim period ended June 30, 2026, with 109 documents spanning financial statements and XBRL tagging. Disclosures reference a post-consolidation share-capital change effective September 9, 2026, affecting both Class A and Class B ordinary shares, alongside related-party loan and deposit balances. No transaction terms, prices per share, premiums, or advisor mandates appear. This is a routine periodic foreign-issuer report, not a special situation; no deal terms or arbitrage angle to monitor.
